name: codex-antigravity-bridge
description: Let Codex delegate bounded coding work to an authenticated local Antigravity CLI session.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded coding tasks to local Antigravity.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial bridge for Codex to orchestrate an authenticated local Antigravity CLI session using Gemini 3.7 Flash. Codex remains responsible for approvals, conflict review, and final verification.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded coding task to Antigravity.
Ask Antigravity to review these files, then verify its findings.
Poll the Antigravity task and summarize changed files.
